operation.description:
Gets the default workflow permissions granted to the `GITHUB_TOKEN` when running workflows in a repository,
as well as if GitHub Actions can submit approving pull request reviews.
For more information, see "[Setting the permissions of the GITHUB_TOKEN for your repository](https://docs.github.com/repositories/managing-your-repositorys-settings-and-features/enabling-features-for-your-repository/managing-github-actions-settings-for-a-repository#setting-the-permissions-of-the-github_token-for-your-repository)."

OAuth tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint.
operation.summary: Get default workflow permissions for a repository

#/components/examples/actions-default-wo.summary: Give read-only permission, and allow approving PRs.

#/components/parameters/owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/owner.name: owner

#/components/parameters/repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/repo.name: repo

#/components/schemas/actions-can-approve.description: Whether GitHub Actions can approve pull requests. Enabling this can be a security risk.

#/components/schemas/actions-default-wor.description: The default workflow permissions granted to the GITHUB_TOKEN when running workflows.
